decisions.decision: Agent service architecture and session model
decisions.choice: Agent runs as SYSTEM in session 0; UI spawned into user sessions
decisions.rationale: SYSTEM session 0 cannot access user clipboard; UI process handles clipboard monitoring and notifications in user sessions.

decisions.choice: Operator config (SIEM, alerts, agent config) lives in SQLite, not env vars
decisions.rationale: Hot-reload without restart; TUI manageable; persistent across restarts. Same pattern applied consistently across all operator-tunable config.

decisions.choice: AppState { db, siem } is the canonical axum state for dlp-server handlers
decisions.rationale: Single shared state struct avoids threading individual components through handler signatures. All handlers use State<Arc<AppState>>.
Import stops at first POST/PUT error showing 'Failed on policy {name}: {reason}'. Prior successes are already persisted server-side — admin does not get a rollback.

decisions.decision: Backward compatibility for boolean mode schema change
decisions.choice: Legacy v0.4.0 policies default to mode=ALL via ALTER TABLE migration
decisions.rationale: Existing rows from v0.4.0 are populated with 'ALL' on migration without manual intervention. Serde defaults mode to ALL when absent on POST/PUT input.

decisions.choice: UsbEnforcer check() fires before offline.evaluate() — None return is zero-cost fast-path
decisions.rationale: None return is zero-cost fast-path for non-USB drives; Some(DENY) short-circuits ABAC entirely. Avoids unnecessary policy evaluation for every I/O operation.

decisions.decision: Test isolation pattern for global OnceLock state
decisions.choice: Thread-local TEST_EVALUATOR_OVERRIDE for Chrome handler parallel test isolation
decisions.rationale: Eliminates parallel test races for Chrome handler ABAC tests without restructuring the entire evaluator to use dependency injection.

decisions.choice: DefineDosDeviceW + IOCTL_VOLUME_OFFLINE hybrid for mount-time blocking
decisions.rationale: DefineDosDeviceW prevents drive letter assignment for new arrivals; IOCTL_VOLUME_OFFLINE handles volumes that already have handles. Both are user-mode APIs requiring no kernel driver.

decisions.choice: User-mode API hooking (IAT) in sync client processes + WFP network egress blocking
decisions.rationale: True file interception without kernel driver or EV code signing. API hooks block writes at CreateFileW/NtCreateFile in sync client processes. WFP provides defense-in-depth for bypasses (direct syscalls, alternative upload paths).

decisions.choice: Spool directory watch + XPS content extraction + SetJob cancellation (medium approach)
decisions.rationale: User-mode only, no port monitor DLL. FindFirstPrinterChangeNotification detects jobs. SHD metadata + SPL XPS parsing extracts content for classification. SetJob(JOB_CONTROL_DELETE) cancels blocked jobs. EMF falls back to metadata-only.

decisions.choice: Registry-based dynamic discovery with hardcoded path fallback
decisions.rationale: Enterprise deployments redirect sync folders. Registry/shell APIs discover actual paths. Hardcoded defaults (%USERPROFILE%\OneDrive, etc.) as fallback when discovery fails.

decisions.choice: Clipboard URL pattern matching + stricter ABAC policy for sync-folder files
decisions.rationale: Local detection of share link creation is provider-specific and fragile. Clipboard monitoring catches share URLs after creation (1drv.ms, drive.google.com/share, dropbox.com/s, box.com/s). Stricter ABAC policy treats all files in sync folders as higher-risk context.
